adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a `raw_html` cook method that makes `Post#cook` return `raw` verbatim (`return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` in app/models/post.rb). Feed polling imports `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb) and passes it into `TopicEmbed.import`, which creates posts via `PostCreator` with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). No sanitization/HTML filtering is applied anywhere on this path; `scrub` only addresses encoding. The embed view renders the result with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (app/views/embed/best.html.erb), and because cooked==raw for `raw_html`, any feed-supplied `<script>` or event-handler attributes would be stored and rendered as HTML, enabling stored XSS.
